quarterly_data.signal: Constellation's 8-K on the PJM capacity auction for the 2028-2029 planning year says each of its power plants in the PJM market cleared, with results taking effect June 1, 2028 (assets held for sale excluded). Its by-zone table of cleared volumes at ownership shows COMED 10,200 MW (9,800 MW nuclear, 400 MW fossil/others), EMAAC 6,550 MW (4,325 MW nuclear, 2,225 MW fossil/others), MAAC 1,725 MW (1,575 MW nuclear, 150 MW fossil/others), BGE 375 MW and RTO 25 MW (all fossil/others), each at a Capacity Performance price of $325.
